title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 69-72 (Vimala, Vishvajanani, Tushti, Daridryanashini)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 69 to 72: Vimala, Vishvajanani, Tushti, Daridryanashini, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 69 to 72 with meaning
caption: Names 69 to 72 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 69 to 72**: **Vimala, Vishvajanani, Tushti, Daridryanashini**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Vimala, Vishvajanani, Tushti, Daridryanashini.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Vimala** means **The Spotless One**. Spotless, pure in mind and form.
**Vishvajanani** means **Mother of the universe**. Mother of the universe, from whom all beings are nourished.
**Tushti** means **Contentment**. Contentment is the real wealth; Lakshmi is called Tushti itself.
**Daridryanashini** means **Destroyer of poverty**. Destroyer of poverty and lack, of means and of spirit.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.

note: Written in our own words from the traditional list of names.
